title: Global:: statics: the third place the compiler looks for a bare call
instruction: Ground with get_knowledge(topic="global-class-statics"). In the sandbox model write a class whose methods call the Global statics that look predefined but are not: hasTableAccess(tableNum(CustGroup), AccessType::View) and hasMenuItemAccess(...) and isSystemAdministrator() for run-time security, isConfigurationkeyEnabled(...) and isRunningOnBatch() for environment, and buf2Buf for a field-by-field copy that skips system fields. Do NOT name SecurityRights: it exists as a kernel class but these Global statics are what shipped code uses. Every call is unqualified - do not prefix them with Global::. Build with zero errors and zero BP errors.
